expectedText: My friends and I have a budget for a small lunch. First, we will write a list and agree on the quantity of each item. I will check the price on every label and put the food in a basket. We need a few vegetables and a little oil, but we do not need a large package of cups. Before we pay, I will add the cost of the items and check the total. If there is a discount, I will check that it appears on the receipt. I may use cash, so I will count the change as well. We will save the money left over and decide together whether we can afford fruit.
